**Body:**

The LA Clippers in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #70 Darius Garland 54.9
- #157 Derrick Jones Jr. 47.1
- #167 Rui Hachimura 46.2
- #179 Brandon Ingram 45.3
- #202 Keaton Wagler 44.1 (rookie)
- #207 Kris Dunn 43.4
- #208 Jordan Miller 43.3
- #239 Max Strus 41.6

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
